summary: Robo.ai Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting its indirect wholly owned subsidiary Roboai Investments L.L.C-FZ entering a Share Purchase Agreement dated June 12, 2026 to acquire 100% of QC Capital Limited, a BVI technology company, for 20,491,805 Class B ordinary shares valued at US$60,000,000. Sellers receive 3% at closing; remaining shares are locked up for 8 years, released in five equal annual tranches starting at the fourth anniversary. Closing is expected on or before July 24, 2026. The acquisition supports Robo.ai's technology development and global commercialization. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or break fee are stated. Watch for regulatory approvals and post-closing integration execution.
